title: xanthocephalum alamanii
intro: Xanthocephalum alamanii, commonly known as yellowhead, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Xanthocephalum alamanii include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and antiseptic activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
